name: Start heist
effect: Build the house and van next to the player, place loot, spawn guards, put the player at the start point, count down, start the timer.

name: Heist timer
trigger: Every server tick while a heist runs
effect: Count down; at zero the heist ends.
feedback: Boss bar that drains; turns red in the last 30 s with a ticking sound.

name: Grab loot
trigger: Crouch (Shift) right next to a loot block or the gnome statue. HeroCraft owns both mouse buttons while a hero weapon is held, so clicking only works with an empty hand.
effect: Take the nearest loot within reach out of the house and add it to what the player carries, up to the carry limit. One grab per crouch.
feedback: Pickup sound; action bar shows carried items and value.

name: Bank at the van
trigger: Player stands in the drop zone carrying loot
effect: Move carried loot to the banked score.

name: Caught by a guard
trigger: A guard lands a hit on the player
effect: Cancel the damage; carried loot is lost; player goes back to the start point; every guard returns to its post and holds still for graceTicks, so nobody camps the van.

name: Stun a guard
trigger: A guard would die (hero weapons, punches)
effect: Cancel the death, heal it, freeze it for the guard's stunSeconds.
feedback: Guard's name shows 'stunned'; it stops moving.

name: End and score
effect: Carried loot is lost; guards and leftover loot are removed; the score card is shown.
feedback: Title with banked total; chat lists each banked item and the best possible total.

name: Clean up on leave
trigger: Player leaves the world, or a saved world reloads with leftovers
effect: Remove guards and the gnome statue and forget the heist.
